outcome: Perception of obesity increasing risk of miscarriage
Perception of obesity increasing risk of irregular period
Perception of obesity increasing risk of infertility
Perception of obesity increasing risk of cesarean section
cohort: The study included 500 young female adults aged 19-35 years from Owo Local Government Area of Ondo State, Nigeria.
finding: The overall knowledge of the health implications of obesity was low among the participants, with only 5% having excellent knowledge.
mod_finding: 42.0% of participants perceived that obesity increases the risk of cesarean section.
